summary: Centerspace filed an 8-K reporting completion of its portfolio optimization plan, selling 14 multifamily communities and a note receivable under four agreements to three unaffiliated buyers. The staggered closings occurred June through August 11, 2026, with aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $318.8 million. Proceeds will repay debt, fund a potential special distribution of $50–60 million, and for general purposes. The board approved the plan following a strategic review. The transactions are classified as a significant disposition. Watch for special distribution timing and further asset sales under the deleveraging plan.
